{"metadata":{"description":"Intelligent LLM routing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: route groups, 4 routing strategies, intent rule engine, cache-affinity Stays mode, auto failover and sample settings UI.","id":"gh:1421736251","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-intelligent-router","slug":"XHToken/dsh-intelligent-router","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","failover","intent-routing","llm-router","load-balancing","plugin","plugins","prompt-cache","sparkllm","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Intelligent LLM routing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: route groups, 4 routing strategies, intent rule"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" engine, cache-affinity Stays mode, auto failover and sample settings UI."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Intelligent Router"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> Intelligent LLM routing for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — Multi-model Routing Strategies, Automatic Fai"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"lover, Cache-affinity Staying, Data Anonymization and a Visual Settings UI."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The router registers itself as the **`auto`** provider in DSH. Pick **AUTO – Intelligent Router** as"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" your model and every request is routed to the best member of your configured route group — with rul"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"es, strategies, failover, and prompt-cache-aware staying working under the hood."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> DSH Intelligent Router registers as the `auto` provider in DeepSeek Harness and routes each reques"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"t through configurable route groups, strategies, intent rules, cache-affinity Stays, and automatic f"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"h configurable route groups, strategies, intent rules, cache-affinity Stays, and automatic failover."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Usage demo"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The screenshot below shows a real DSH chat flow with `AUTO - Intelligent Router`: the request is cla"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ssified, matched against routing rules, and served by the selected provider/model member."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Routing details"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Request lifecycle"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Settings and live persistence"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Strategies, route groups, and Stays"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Routing
- **Route groups** — organize members (provider + model) and manage them from the Settin"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"gs UI
- **Four routing strategies** — `order` (priority) · `smart` (task-size aware: local vs cloud)"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" · `rotate` (round-robin) · `usage` (least-used first)
- **Rule engine** — `minTokens` / `hasImage` "},{"id":"p14s4","text":"/ `anyAgent` / `intent` conditions; the first matching rule pins its target model to the front of th"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"e candidate chain
- **Intent routing** — a lightweight classifier model (your choice) labels the mes"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"sage intent; rules route on it
- **Stays (cache affinity)** — `off` / `turn` / `auto` / `session` (d"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"efault `session`): keeps the last successful member at the front while the vendor prompt cache is wo"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"rth keeping, keyed per DSH session"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Reliability
- **Automatic failover** — three-tier error classification (TRANSIENT / PERMANENT / "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"UNKNOWN), no false positives: auth and validation errors never burn retries; connection, rate-limit,"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" and 5xx errors fall through to the next candidate
- **Quota guard** — members that exceed limits ar"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"e skipped without consuming a retry"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Experience
- **Settings UI** (Magpie-style, zh/en) — model picker fed from DSH's configured mode"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ls, strategy pills, rule builder, intent-classifier selection, save-time validation, live persistenc"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"e via the DSH settings service
- **Observability** — per-group/per-member metrics, latency tracking,"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" cost estimates, and `router/fallback` events (host side)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` (declared in `compatibility.json`)
- Node.js `>= 18` (DSH runtime"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"), pnpm for development"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"> [!WARNING]
> **First-time install requires a DSH restart.** The plugin's loader entry and client b"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"undle are composed into the boot graph **at server startup**.
> If DSH is already running when you i"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"nstall, it will not notice the new package — the Settings UI (and the `auto` provider) will be missi"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ng until you restart.
> Stop the running `dsh web` process and start it again; a browser reload alon"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"e is not enough. Subsequent changes to routing config (Save in the Settings UI) or rebuilt plugin bu"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"ndles are picked up live via HMR — only package-level install/remove needs a restart.
> **Waiting fo"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"r DSH support in the future.**"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"> Start DSH from the profile directory with the **local binary** (`cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && ./node_"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"modules/.bin/dsh web --port 3082`). Launching via `npx` can load a duplicate module tree and break s"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"h web --port 3082`). Launching via `npx` can load a duplicate module tree and break settings writes."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Quick Start"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. Start DSH and open **Settings → Built-in plugins → LLM Router**
2. Click **+ Add model** to pick "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"members from your DSH-configured providers
3. Choose a strategy (default: `order`); optionally add r"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ules
4. Click **Save** (persists immediately via the DSH settings service)
5. In chat, select **AUTO"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" – Intelligent Router** — done"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Use a specific group with provider `group/<groupId>`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Configuration Reference"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Persisted by the Settings UI into the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`id: llm-router`). - Magpie Integration Design

- DeepSeek Harne"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ss Architecture Analysis
- Usage examples — reproducible cases with screenshots (agent-teams, coding"},{"id":"p31s3","text":", document pipeline, data anonymization, image redesign), indexed by the `dsh-router-examples` skill"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"CI runs the quality pipeline on every push, and an E2E workflow installs the plugin into a real DSH "},{"id":"p34s2","text":"host afterwards (boot → restart → Settings UI bundle contract → doctor)."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Roadmap"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- `pace` / `weighted` / `intent` strategies are declared in the schema but **not implemented** (they"},{"id":"p36s2","text":" silently degrade to `order`) — implement or prune
- Stays windows (`turn` ≈ 2 min, `auto` ≈ 5 min) "},{"id":"p36s3","text":"are hardcoded approximations — make configurable
- Quota limits are hardcoded (1M tokens/day, 1k req"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"uests/day) and never auto-reset — wire up `quotaTracking.limits`
- Monitoring data has no UI channel"},{"id":"p36s5","text":" yet (panel shows mock data)
- Middleware system is implemented but not wired into the request path
